what_happened: Scene: layout 4, small black single-pair toaster with its lever on the front face (same kitchen as s5/s10/s17/s24), bread in the left slot. Stage 0: from 118 to 504 the open gripper sat on top of the toaster over the slots (contact almost continuous), without moving anything (lever 0). The fingers closed at 478-510 on nothing (no bread contact). 569-673 the closed fist pressed DOWN on the bread top, which lay tilted in the slot (bread contact 569-672, 'hold' with lift 0). That pushed the carriage to only 0.27-0.32 (bread -1.6 cm), held for ~100 steps. The lever handle on the front face was never pushed. The fist let go at ~673 and the carriage sprang back by 752. From ~700 to 2000 the arm hovered around and above the toaster with the bread in view, with only two brief toaster touches (1860-1884, 1949-1984). The toaster was never on and the bread stayed in the slot.
causal_chain: ~390 steps resting on the toaster top (118-504) -> pushed down on the bread top instead of the front lever, reaching only 0.32 (569-673; 0.9 needed) -> hovered beside the toaster 700-2000 -> toaster never on

packet_facts: gripper open until 488, closed 528-2000; close_events 478, 510 on nothing

uncertain_about: Whether the fist at 569-673 was on the bread only, or also partly on the carriage; either way the lever handle on the front face was untouched.
